exposure: surgical bundle (standard preprocedure prophylactic antibiotics, 48-hour course of oral cephalexin and metronidazole)
cohort: Individuals with morbid obesity (BMI ≥ 40 kg/m²) undergoing cesarean delivery at ≥ 23 weeks of gestation.
finding: The implemented surgical bundle increased antibiotic use but did not significantly reduce surgical site infections, hospital readmission, ED visits, or wound complications.
